measurement_note: Size is n, the string length. Each tier contains n-1 copies of a followed by one b, so the best variance is n-2 and the only minor must be retained. The ordered-pair Kadane scans take O(n) time over the fixed alphabet. Correct incremental enumeration of every substring completes all tiers and fails only through O(n^2) scaling.
